title: Super Real Mahjong P7 P's Club Special: A-bus settings
summary: Preserve the inherited removal of this game’s ASR0 store.
rationale: Preserve the original SAROO compatibility edit on this exact disc source, with complete FILE hash, raw-sector and preimage guards. See doc/OCTOBER-REVISION-PROFILES.md for source, instruction, callback-delivery evidence and timing/audio/physical limits. Keep opt-in with the original callback available.

writes.effect: NOP MOV.L R3,@R2 at 06011208; the preceding literals resolve R2 to ASR0(25FE00B0) and R3 to 23301FF0.
